items.title: I've been at Anthropic through every model launch. There's been a few cases I can remember of a…
items.content: I've been at Anthropic through every model launch. There's been a few cases I can remember of a launch that stands out and marks a step-change in how we use models: - Claude Opus 3 - Claude Sonnet 3.5 - Claude Opus 4.5 And now Claude Fable 5. With Fable, the model stopped feeling like a tool I direct and started feeling more like something I collaborate with.
